message.content: In this directory, make exactly these three changes with your tools, one call at a time, in this order: 1) with the Edit tool, change the line `the middle line` in notes.txt to `the MIDDLE line`; 2) with one Edit call using replace_all true, replace every `apple` in notes.txt with `pear`; 3) with the Write tool, replace the whole content of other.txt with the two lines `new other text` and `second line`. Then reply DONE.
